title: Describe automatic portfolio runs without implying blocking human decisions
description:
The living Report introduction currently says every portfolio run follows analysis through human decisions, even when execution_mode is automatic and optimization launch does not wait for human approval. This misstates the active workflow at the most visible point of the Report.

Feature: Mode-accurate portfolio report introduction

Scenario: Automatic execution introduction
  Given a portfolio run uses automatic execution mode
  When its living Report is rendered
  Then the introduction explains that policy-selected safe targets may launch automatically
  And it states that champion promotion remains manual
  And it does not imply a blocking optimization-approval decision

Scenario: Approval-required introduction
  Given a portfolio run uses approval-required mode
  When its living Report is rendered
  Then the introduction explains the human optimization-approval checkpoint

No client information is included. No execution semantics change is in scope.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Started outside-in implementation. I will add a focused rendered-report specification for both execution modes, then make the smallest presentation-only change. Scope excludes procedure behavior and all production mutations.

Dashboard status card mirrors the same distinction. comments.text: Review follow-up started: making frozen run_spec.execution_mode the sole authority for Report, workbook, presentation, and dashboard-facing mode copy. Any contradictory downstream decision evidence will be rejected fail-closed; adding mismatch specifications before implementation.

comments.author: ryan.porter
